scope: Four previously unused layouts in the existing procedural static scene family; not camera perception, SLAM or real hardware.
order: Alternate condition order by seed index; run all declared seeds, including those without a correction opportunity.

plan.intent: 青を探索して帰還。訂正後も元の帰還と期限を保持

trigger: After a >=2-ray green observation, first scan with green absent, no blue observation in history, and elapsed <=90 seconds. All information comes from the robot's sensor log.
second_message: Two simulation seconds after the first interpretation finishes, whether accepted or clarification; same rule in both conditions.
messages: さっき見た緑を確認し直してから、青の探索を再開して
青は探さなくていいです。緑の再確認を続けて、最後に戻って
青を探す前に、先ほど見えた緑をもう一度見てきて
青の探索は中止。緑を見直す作業は残して、終わったら出発地点へ
さっきの緑を再確認するのを先にして。その後は青を探して帰って
やっぱり青は取り消します。緑の再確認と帰還はそのままで
青の探索はいったん後にして、前に見えた緑を改めて確認して
青探しはやめて。緑をもう一度確認して戻る予定は維持して
ablation: current_only changes only context.observations: retain records from the latest sensor scan and records already referenced by active tasks. Keep pending/completed/cancelled tasks, dialogue, map summary, home, deadline and controller identical. Do not remove observations from the executor or its validator.
success: Both messages received; accepted observation-grounded green reobserve; blue explicitly cancelled with a user quote; fresh >=2-ray green evidence after last activation; home completed, no pending tasks, home error <=0.15m, within original180s; original deadline/home retained, zero velocity commands during model/question waits; finite upright trace without obstacle contact.
freeze_rule: Commit protocol, harness and source before inspecting any declared layout. Save fingerprints before first scene. No tuning on these seeds; if source or protocol changes after results are inspected, relabel these layouts as development and declare new seeds.
limits: Only four paired layouts, one language variant each and stochastic model latency. No statistical superiority claim; record non-triggered cases without replacing them. Initial plan is fixed to isolate correction interpretation; no live initial-language inference is evaluated. Stop entire batch on model infrastructure failure, preserve partial records, resume only with matching frozen inputs.
